## Activity

East City Eye Clinic recorded 174 captures during May 2019. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and reflects the imaging work completed at the site. The activity figure is presented for routine operational monitoring and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

There were 4 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 2.3 per cent. This result is reported alongside the total capture activity to support review of image acquisition and identify any need for local follow-up. No new equipment faults were raised by staff during the month.

## Grading

A total of 24 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 6. This information is reported with the site activity and image-quality measures to give an overall view of the month’s operational performance. The figures should be considered together when reviewing the service delivered at East City Eye Clinic during May 2019.
